name: Jest on File Change
description: Automatically runs related Jest tests after a source file is modified, providing immediate feedback on test results
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run related Jest tests after file change
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Skip test files themselves
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(test|spec)\. ]]; then exit 0; fi
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/jest.config.js" || -f "$ROOT/jest.config.ts" || -f "$ROOT/jest.config.json" ]]; then
    BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//')
    echo "Running Jest tests related to $BASENAME..."
    cd "$ROOT" && npx jest --findRelatedTests "$FILE" --passWithNoTests 2>/dev/null | tail -5
  fi
fi
exit 0
